latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the OpenSETI distributed scanner.
- Users can contribute compute power to analyze real radio telescope data from Breakthrough Listen.
- Token rewards offered for detecting anomalies matching ETI signal criteria.
- Supports registration of Solana wallets and various scan modes (single, continuous).
- Command-line interface with commands for registration, scanning, stats, and leaderboard.
- Integration with real data from Green Bank and Parkes observatories.
